subject: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling - traffic replay & capacity sizing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling - traffic replay & capacity sizing

Thanks again for the call today, Tom - good discussion. Per our MAP draft (attached), the next milestone is scheduling a load/performance replay so we can validate latency and throughput under realistic traffic, and size a Dedicated capacity if needed.

Quick recap of what we captured:
- Milestone: Run traffic replay (customer-provided sample) against a staging endpoint.
- Responsibilities: FintechCorp to provide scrubbed traffic sample and S3 access; Redwood to run replay and provide sizing recommendation and results.
- Target MAP close date: 2026-08-10 (we can update based on test date).
- Dependencies: traffic sample, test credentials, and confirmation of peak QPS and expected spike patterns.

Ask: can you confirm the week that works for you for the replay? We typically run replay windows Monday-Thursday 2-6 hours (including ramp/soak), but can adapt. Also please indicate:
- expected peak QPS (approx) and any spike patterns
- whether you want us to provision Dedicated capacity for the run or test on hosted first
- who from your CloudOps should be the technical contact (for presigned S3 links / network allowlist)

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (updated with milestones), sample traffic file stub referenced below.

If it helps, I can loop in Aditya (SE) and Vivek (Solutions Eng) to confirm technical approach.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-draft-v2.xlsx]

- Peak QPS: sustained ~1,200 qps during normal peak; short spikes up to ~1,500 qps for ~5-10 minutes during end-of-day batch windows.
- Traffic sample: we have a 2-day anonymized sample (June 15-16) ready. I can share a presigned S3 link.
- Environment: we have a staging cluster that mirrors production but we would prefer Redwood to recommend Dedicated sizing; procurement is flexible but we want confidence on sizing before commit.
- Preferred week for replay: week of July 27 (Mon 7/27-Thu 7/30).

Contact for access: CloudOps team (cloudops@fintechcorp.com) will provide the presigned S3 link and any IP allowlist.

Would you and your SRE/SE team confirm the expected duration and any replay constraints?

Best,

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling - traffic replay & capacity sizing

Thanks for the context - plan below. I copied Tom so FintechCorp sees the proposed test mechanics.

High-level replay plan:
- Prep: FintechCorp provides presigned S3 path with scrubbed HTTP request traces (we need request method, URL, headers minus auth tokens, and request body where applicable).
- Replay window: 1) 30m ramp from 10%->100% of target QPS, 2) 2h steady at target QPS (1,200 qps), 3) 30m ramp down.
- Spike test: run a separate 20-30m spike test to validate behavior at 1,500 qps.
- Observability: we will stream logs/latency metrics to your staging monitoring and provide a Redwood perf report (p50/p95/p99, token cost estimate, concurrency, and KV cache hit rates).

Sizing recommendation: 
- To hit sustained 1,200 qps with predictable headroom, recommend Dedicated pool equivalent to 6x A100-80GB (or cloud equivalent). If they want conservative headroom for spikes and future growth, size to 8x A100-80GB.
- If customer prefers hosted first, we can do the test on hosted with throttles but results will be less predictive for a Dedicated commit.

Network / creds / artifacts needed:
- Presigned S3 URL to scrubbed traces (or temporary S3 credentials).
- If traffic requires hitting internal endpoints, IPs that Redwood will use must be allowlisted (I will provide IP ranges once we lock schedule).
- Confirm whether tokens are scrubbed; we cannot replay live auth tokens - ideally use anonymized IDs.

Attachments: perf-test-checklist.pdf (runbook + checklist).

Next steps: if FintechCorp confirms week of 7/27, we will reserve capacity and send a proposed run schedule (date/time + expected downtime/impact). Please confirm preferred day/time window and whether they want the spike test included in the same window or a separate run.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: perf-test-checklist.pdf]

From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@fintechcorp.com>

Subject: Re: MAP: Load/perf test scheduling - traffic replay & capacity sizing

- S3 sample: presigned link (expires 7/26 23:59 UTC) - https://s3.amazonaws.com/fintechcorp/test/fintechcorp_traffic_sample_0615.json.gz (CloudOps will rotate if you need a later link).
- Tokens: we scrubbed auth headers and replaced IDs with synthetic values.
- Peak behavior: confirm 1,200 sustained, spikes to 1,500 for <10 minutes.
- Capacity: procurement is comfortable with your recommendation; we'll plan for Dedicated sizing at 8x A100-equivalent for initial commit to give headroom.
- Preferred window: Mon 7/27 09:00-13:00 PT (include spike test at ~11:00 PT).

We will provide CloudOps point-of-contact (Sam) for any network allowlist work - sam.cloudops@fintechcorp.com. Please send the Redwood IP ranges and any IAM expectations.

Please update the MAP milestone target close date to 2026-08-10 post-test. Laura (CC'd from our side) will coordinate procurement next steps.

Looking forward to the run.
Tom
